label: Gala

provenance.incarnation: MGS3 original 1964 Major Zero: mature middle-aged pale English man, broad brow, deep stern face, silver-gray swept-back hair and over-ear radio headset; natural bare hands. Do not age him into MGS4. Original CQC gala outfit; no official retail gala costume claimed.

sources.scope: Physically viewed official original-incarnation identity reference. Gala garments and combat motion are authored CQC adaptations; unseen original full-body garments are not certified.
